readme:
# Shopify Store Scraper

Scrape products from any Shopify store via the public `/products.json` endpoint. Returns product details, descriptions, prices, discount info, variant data, images, and store metadata. No login required. Pay-per-result.

## Features

- **Any Shopify store** — works with myshopify.com subdomains and custom domains
- **Complete product data** — title, description, vendor, type, tags, all images, options, price range, discount detection
- **Variant details** — optional full variant data with SKU, individual prices, option values, and weight
- **Store metadata** — name, domain, email, phone, currency, country, Shopify plan from `/shop.json`
- **Automatic pagination** — fetches all pages up to your limit (250 per page)
- **Automatic fallback** — tries `/collections/all/products.json` if `/products.json` is blocked
- **Deduplication** — no duplicate product IDs per store

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/shopify-store-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `shopify-store-scraper` to extract all products from allbirds.com and gymshark.com. Return a table with product name, vendor, price range, and availability."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output Data

Each record represents one product, with store metadata embedded:

### Product Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `product_id` | string | Shopify product ID |
| `product_title` | string | Product title |
| `product_handle` | string | URL slug |
| `product_type` | string\|null | Merchant-assigned product type |
| `description` | string\|null | Product description (HTML stripped to plain text) |
| `vendor` | string\|null | Brand or vendor name |
| `tags` | array | Merchant-assigned tags |
| `min_price` | number\|null | Lowest variant price |
| `max_price` | number\|null | Highest variant price |
| `compare_at_price_min` | number\|null | Lowest original/compare-at price (indicates discount) |
| `compare_at_price_max` | number\|null | Highest original/compare-at price |
| `currency` | string\|null | Store default currency |
| `available` | boolean | True if any variant is purchasable |
| `variant_count` | integer | Number of variants (sizes, colors, etc.) |
| `image_url` | string\|null | Primary product image URL |
| `image_urls` | array | All product image URLs |
| `options` | array | Product options with values (e.g. `{name: "Size", values: ["S","M","L"]}`) |
| `variants` | array\|null | Full variant details (only when `includeVariants` is enabled) |
| `product_url` | string | Direct link to the product page |
| `product_created_at` | string\|null | ISO 8601 creation timestamp |
| `product_updated_at` | string\|null | ISO 8601 last-updated timestamp |
| `product_published_at` | string\|null | ISO 8601 publish timestamp |

### Variant Fields (when `includeVariants: true`)

Each variant in the `variants` array contains:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | Variant ID |
| `title` | string | Variant title (e.g. "M / Black") |
| `sku` | string | Stock Keeping Unit code |
| `price` | number | Variant price |
| `compare_at_price` | number\|null | Original price before discount |
| `available` | boolean | Whether this variant is in stock |
| `option1` | string\|null | First option value (e.g. "Medium") |
| `option2` | string\|null | Second option value (e.g. "Black") |
| `option3` | string\|null | Third option value |
| `grams` | integer | Weight in grams |

### Store Fields (embedded per product)

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `store_url` | string | Store URL as provided in input |
| `store_name` | string\|null | Store display name |
| `store_domain` | string\|null | Primary domain |
| `store_myshopify_domain` | string\|null | myshopify.com subdomain |
| `store_description` | string\|null | Store description |
| `store_email` | string\|null | Contact email (if publicly exposed) |
| `store_phone` | string\|null | Phone number (if publicly exposed) |
| `store_currency` | string\|null | Default currency code |
| `store_country` | string\|null | Country code |
| `store_country_name` | string\|null | Country full name |
| `store_plan` | string\|null | Shopify plan name |
| `store_created_at` | string\|null | ISO 8601 store creation timestamp |
| `scraped_at` | string | ISO 8601 scrape timestamp |

## Input

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `storeUrls` | array | *required* | List of Shopify store URLs to scrape |
| `maxProductsPerStore` | integer | 250 | Maximum products per store (1-10,000) |
| `includeVariants` | boolean | false | Include full variant details (SKU, prices, options, weight) per product |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | DATACENTER | Proxy settings |

## Input Examples

### Scrape a single store
```json
{
  "storeUrls": ["https://allbirds.com"],
  "maxProductsPerStore": 500
}
```

### Scrape multiple stores with variant details
```json
{
  "storeUrls": [
    "https://gymshark.com",
    "https://fashionnova.com",
    "https://ruggable.com"
  ],
  "maxProductsPerStore": 250,
  "includeVariants": true
}
```

### Scrape with myshopify.com domains
```json
{
  "storeUrls": ["https://gymshark.myshopify.com"],
  "maxProductsPerStore": 100
}
```

## Pricing

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start | $0.25 |
| `shopify-product-result` | $1.00 / 1,000 products |

## Notes

- **Fallback endpoint**: If `/products.json` is blocked, the actor automatically tries `/collections/all/products.json` as a fallback.
- **Email/phone availability**: Shopify's `/shop.json` endpoint exposes contact details at the store's discretion. Many stores omit them; the fields will be `null` if not present.
- **Pagination**: Shopify returns up to 250 products per page. The actor paginates automatically using the legacy `?page=N` parameter, which works on all Shopify stores.
- **Custom domains**: The actor follows HTTP redirects, so custom domains pointing to Shopify backends are fully supported.
- **No anti-bot**: Shopify's `/products.json` endpoint is intentionally public and requires no authentication or cookies.
- **Discount detection**: Compare `min_price` with `compare_at_price_min` to identify products on sale.
